claims: Chipotle is offering a Buy One, Get One (BOGO) free entrée deal on April 20, 2026.
Chipotle's BOGO free entrée deal is for customers wearing a hockey jersey.
Chipotle's BOGO free entrée deal is available at participating locations after 3 p.m. local time.
Chipotle's BOGO free entrée deal celebrates the start of the NHL Stanley Cup Playoffs.
Chipotle's 2026 deal is on Monday, April 20, 2026.
Chipotle's 2026 deal is available from 3 p.m. to closing.
Chipotle's 2026 deal offers buy one entrée and get one free of equal or lesser value.
Entrées for Chipotle's 2026 deal include burrito, bowl, salad, or taco order.
A hockey jersey must be worn in-restaurant to redeem Chipotle's 2026 deal.
Chipotle's 2026 deal is available at participating U.S. and Canadian locations.
Chipotle's 2026 deal is for in-store orders only.
Chipotle's 2026 deal has a limit of 5 free items per check.
Chipotle's promotion coincides with the NHL playoffs.
Chipotle's promotion is not officially branded as a "4/20" promotion
